name: terradb
description: Declarative schema management for PostgreSQL and SQLite

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --outdir ./dist --target node --external libpg-query --external libsql
scripts.test:core: bun --env-file=.env test --max-concurrency=1 src/test/schema-service.test.ts src/test/schema-service-private-coverage.test.ts src/test/schema-differ-private-coverage.test.ts src/test/schema-parser-private-coverage.test.ts src/test/parser-edge-coverage.test.ts src/test/inspector-coverage.test.ts src/test/clean-database.test.ts
scripts.test:coverage: bun --env-file=.env test --parallel=6 --max-concurrency=1 --timings=tools/test-timings.json --coverage --coverage-reporter=lcov --timeout 120000 $(find src/test -type f -name '*.test.ts' -not -path 'src/test/columns/performance/*' -not -path 'src/test/properties/*' -not -path 'src/test/extensions/*' | sort) && bun run tools/check-coverage-gate.ts coverage/lcov.info 95 95 src/core/schema/parser:98:98 src/core/schema/differ.ts:98:98 src/core/schema/inspector.ts:98:98 src/core/schema/service.ts:98:98
scripts.test:coverage:full: bun --env-file=.env test --parallel --max-concurrency=1 --timings=tools/test-timings.json --coverage --coverage-reporter=lcov --timeout 120000 src/test && bun run tools/check-coverage-gate.ts coverage/lcov.info 95 95 src/core/schema/parser:98:98 src/core/schema/differ.ts:98:98 src/core/schema/inspector.ts:98:98 src/core/schema/service.ts:98:98
scripts.test:pg:matrix: bun --env-file=.env test --parallel --max-concurrency=1 --timings=tools/test-timings.json --timeout 120000 $(find src/test -type f -name '*.test.ts' | grep -Ev '^src/test/(sqlite|extensions|columns/performance|properties)/' | sort)
scripts.test:property:nightly: for seed in 20260218 20260219 20260220; do echo "FC_SEED=$seed"; TERRADB_TEST_SILENT=${TERRADB_TEST_SILENT:-1} FC_SEED=$seed bun --env-file=.env test src/test/properties/ || exit 1; done
scripts.test:property:replay: if [ -z "$FC_SEED" ]; then echo "FC_SEED is required" && exit 1; fi; if [ -n "$FC_PATH" ] && [ -z "$FC_TARGET" ]; then echo "FC_TARGET is required when FC_PATH is set" && exit 1; fi; TARGET=${FC_TARGET:-src/test/properties/}; TERRADB_TEST_SILENT=${TERRADB_TEST_SILENT:-1} FC_PATH=${FC_PATH:-} bun --env-file=.env test $TARGET
scripts.test:mutation:changed:report: rm -f coverage/mutation/mutation-report.json && bun run tools/check-mutation-gate.ts --mode report --threshold 85 --min-risk high --out coverage/mutation/changed-files-baseline.json && bun run tools/run-mutation-changed.ts --baseline coverage/mutation/changed-files-baseline.json --report coverage/mutation/mutation-report.json
scripts.test:mutation:changed:gate: bun run test:mutation:changed:report && bun run tools/check-mutation-gate.ts --mode gate --threshold 85 --min-risk high --out coverage/mutation/changed-files-baseline.json --report coverage/mutation/mutation-report.json
scripts.test:flake: for run in 1 2 3; do echo "flake run $run"; bun --env-file=.env test --parallel --timings=tools/test-timings.json src/test/cli src/test/advisory-lock.test.ts src/test/sqlite || exit 1; done
scripts.test:perf:gate: bun run test:perf && bun run tools/check-perf-gate.ts coverage/perf-report.json VARCHAR_to_TEXT_small:250 VARCHAR_to_TEXT_medium:250 INTEGER_to_BIGINT_small:250 INTEGER_to_BIGINT_medium:250 DECIMAL_precision_increase_medium:300 DECIMAL_precision_decrease_medium:250 MULTI_COLUMN_conversion:300 LARGE_STRING_conversion:250
scripts.test:setup:local: docker compose up -d && bun --env-file=.env run src/test/setup.ts
scripts.test:full: bun run test:setup:local && bun run test && bun run test:teardown
scripts.test:full:with-performance: bun run test:setup:local && bun run test && bun run test:teardown
scripts.test:unit: bun --env-file=.env test --parallel --timings=tools/test-timings.json --timeout 120000 src/test/tables.test.ts src/test/columns/constraints/ src/test/columns/core-operations/ src/test/columns/edge-cases/ src/test/columns/type-conversions/ src/test/indexes/
scripts.test:constraints: bun --env-file=.env test src/test/columns/constraints/ src/test/columns/core-operations/ src/test/columns/edge-cases/ src/test/columns/type-conversions/
scripts.test:matrix:pr: bun run test:doctor && bun run test:unit && bun run test:sqlite && bun run test:pg:14 && bun run test:pg:18 && bun run test:pg:extensions && bun run test:e2e && bun run test:property:pr && bun run test:flake && bun run test:coverage && bun run build
scripts.test:matrix:nightly: bun run test:doctor && bun run test:sqlite && bun run test:pg:14 && bun run test:pg:15 && bun run test:pg:16 && bun run test:pg:17 && bun run test:pg:extensions && bun run test:e2e && bun run test:property:nightly && bun run test:flake && bun run test:coverage:full && bun run test:perf && bun run build
